title: F5 releases urgent patches for critical BIG-IP remote code execution flaws
summary: Network security vendor F5 has released emergency patches for five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to execute remote code or trigger denial-of-service attacks.

title: Microsoft Warns of Phishing Campaign Exploiting 365 Outage Incident
summary: Microsoft alerted users to phishing emails impersonating Microsoft 365 service notices that referenced the recent outage to threaten message deletion.
takeaways: Campaign originated from three sender domains: moments-notice.com, planetmaison.com, newbooker.com
Referenced legitimate incident EX1550543 to appear authentic
Redirected users to reallifeaccounting.com/themelist0.html via SendGrid tracking links
Microsoft confirmed credential phishing but no confirmed credential theft or malware delivery yet
Use Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Threat Explorer to identify suspicious emails
